rv.q: A Play, a Pie and a Pint presents an interesting – and impressively polished – hip-hop musical about the life and legacy of William Wallace

Dave Hook, Manasa Tagica and Patricia Panther, as the three performer,s work wonderfully as a dynamic trio that bounce off each other with brilliant chemistry that exposes crucial clashes in the systemised power dynamics between English and Scottish identities, as well as gendered disparities in archival history.
